create_rl_environment: create an rl_environment.Environment for a game by name or pyspiel game instance with optional parameters
test_rl_environment_reset: test the rl_environment.Environment reset method returns a time step with observations and step type
test_rl_environment_step: test the rl_environment.Environment step method advances the game and returns updated time step
test_rl_environment_observation_spec: test the rl_environment.Environment observation_spec and action_spec methods return correct specs
test_rl_environment_state_transfer: test the rl_environment.Environment get_state and set_state methods transfer state between identical games
